violations.rule_text: Operands shall not be implicitly converted to a different essential type
violations.message: Implicit conversion from uint16_t to int16_t may cause sign issues for values > 32767
violations.remediation_hint: Add range check before cast or document that values are always within int16_t range

violations.rule_text: Both operands of an operator shall have the same essential type category
violations.message: Loop variable 'i' declared as signed int but compared with unsigned value *pLength
violations.remediation_hint: Change loop variable declaration to uint16_t to match the type of *pLength

violations.rule_text: All if...else if constructs shall be terminated with an else clause
violations.code_snippet: if (rxMessage.message_length <= 4u) { ... } else { if (rxMessage.message_length == 5u) { ... } else { if (rxMessage.message_length == 6u) { ... } else { ... }}}
violations.message: Nested if-else chain for message_length parsing. While logically complete, the nested structure makes the final else implicit rather than explicit
violations.remediation_hint: Consider restructuring to a flat if-else-if chain with explicit final else, or use switch statement for message_length values
violations.deviation_justification: Nested structure handles all valid message lengths (4-7) with explicit else for length 7 case. Code is functionally complete.

deviations.justification: Configuration constants (N77X_USE_MUX_FOR_TEMP, N77X_CHECK_MUX_STATE, N77X_CHECK_SUPPLY_CURRENT, ftsk_allQueuesCreated) are used for compile-time and runtime feature selection. This is an intentional design pattern in foxBMS to enable/disable features without code modification. The conditions are deterministic by design.
deviations.risk_assessment: Low - Compiler optimization removes dead code paths. No runtime impact.

deviations.justification: The nested if-else structure in N77x_CommunicationDecomposeMessage() handles all valid message_length values (4, 5, 6, 7). The final else clause handles the case where message_length is 7 (the maximum). The code is functionally complete and tested.
deviations.risk_assessment: Low - All code paths are covered by unit tests

notes: Required rule violations (Rule 14.3, Rule 15.7) have documented deviations with justifications

Code follows foxBMS coding standards and patterns

recommendations.description: Review uint16_t to int16_t casts in measurement code
